paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai be-Rabbi Yishmael: Bava Metzia 86b. In Rabbi Shimon Berabbi’s time; this requires examination. Rav Ashi transmitted in his name: Taanit, at the printed locator י״ד ח׳ (the matching passage is 14a). Rabbi Zeaira sent Rabbi Nachum to him: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 4, mishnah 3. Before that passage: Rabbi Yinai in Rabbi Yishmael’s name—it should read be-Rabbi Yishmael—in Rabbi Yinai’s house’s name. Rabbi Zerikan in Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, HaArel, halakhah 1. Rabbi Yehoshua bar Zeidel questioned him. In Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Demai, chapter 4. Rabbi Yishmael ben Zerud went to question him. In Resh Lakish’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Eruvin, chapter 1, and Taanit, chapter 1.
